2027 Airshow Season

Every confirmed U.S. airshow for 2027 — dates, places, headliners, and performer lists where announced — plus road-trip maps for shows within a 9-hour drive of Kansas City and Denver. Season runs March 13 – November 14, 2027.

Read before you plan: The Blue Angels 2027 schedule is published and final. The Thunderbirds 2027 list is preliminary (released December 2025) — those dates can change, with updates expected at the December 2026 ICAS convention. Schedule compiled November 7, 2026 and updated November 25, 2026 (two shows found during performer research added); check the official links at the bottom before booking travel.

Full schedule

Search by show, city, or venue — or filter by headliner. Each card lists its 2027 performers where they've been announced — open “Performers” on a card. “Directions” opens Google Maps for that venue.

Performer key (researched November 19, 2026, from public websites and forums only): Confirmed named for 2027 on an official show/base site or team schedule · Reported public forum or secondary source, not yet official · Unresolved conflicting public claims. Thunderbirds billings follow the team's preliminary schedule. If a show hasn't announced 2027 performers, the card says “lineup not yet announced” — 2026 lineups are never carried over. So far: 6 of the 73 shows have a full published lineup, 17 have a headliner plus a few acts or a disputed billing, 47 are headliner-only, and 3 have none yet; most full lineups are expected after the December 7–10, 2026 ICAS convention.

Road-trip maps

Worth knowing

  • Only double bill: The Great New England Air Show (Chicopee, MA, May 22–23) is the only 2027 show with both the Blue Angels and the Thunderbirds.
  • May 1–2 conflict: Hill AFB (Layton, UT) and Langley AFB (Hampton, VA) both claim the Thunderbirds the same weekend — but the team's own preliminary schedule lists only Langley; Hill's billing comes from the base/organizer (announced Oct 6, 2026, tickets on sale). Unresolved until the final schedule.
  • USAFA graduation date: the preliminary schedule says May 27, but the Academy's dates point to June 3, 2027 — verify before traveling.
  • Atlantic City: the organizer announced June 4–6, 2027 dates with the lineup unfinalized, conflicting with the May 29–30 Blue Angels billing — in doubt.
  • Stuart: the Nov 12–14 dates and any 2027 headliner could not be verified in public sources.
  • Florida International (Punta Gorda): confirmed no 2027 show — it moves to April 2028.
  • Beale (Apr 17–18): show confirmed, headlined by the U-2 Dragon Lady demo; a Thunderbirds billing there is unconfirmed.
  • Dyess (Apr 24–25): tentative — single directory source; the Dyess 7 FSS page lists Apr 23–24, and no 2027 headliner is confirmed.
  • Air races moved: there is no 2027 Reno airshow; the National Championship Air Races are in Roswell, NM, Sep 15–19.
